defect_found_on_deployed_target_2026_11_.symptom: A stop decided before issuer research (unknown issuer, ticket too old, or rental-company paid) left the customer unable to appeal again: POST /workspaces -> 409 appeal_already_started and a corrected intake -> 409 intake_already_submitted_create_new_workspace (whose remedy is 'start a new workspace').
defect_found_on_deployed_target_2026_11_.root_cause_1: CaseService._finished_transaction only inspected case rows; a pre-hold stop never creates one, so the workspace looked live forever.
defect_found_on_deployed_target_2026_11_.root_cause_2: With cookie auth, POST /workspaces returned the owner's existing workspace before create_workspace() ran, so the assisted restart path was unreachable for every authenticated customer.
defect_found_on_deployed_target_2026_11_.fix: treat a saved pre-hold Stop as a finished transaction and let the auth route fall through to create_workspace() when the transaction is finished
